diagnostics.title: Target version is missing or only implied

If proceeding, state the exact latest bundled version assumption before generating output.
Mark missing target-version evidence as a gap instead of filling it from memory.

diagnostics.title: Paper inventory delivery can leave items unaccounted for
detectWhen: plugin code grants, rewards, restores, or otherwise inserts items into a player inventory

a code path that consumes every returned uninserted stack without recreating the original input

Return or record an outcome that distinguishes complete delivery, partial delivery with recovered fallback, deferral or rejection without mutation, and failure with undelivered stacks preserved.

diagnostics.failureMode: Ignored or double-processed leftovers can silently destroy rewards or duplicate items during partial insertion and retry.

Paper event behavior documentation for cancellation, raw-slot sets, deprecated cursor mutation, affected-slot mutations, and restricted in-handler view transitions

an explicit interaction allowlist, session ownership and terminal-state model, settlement and overflow outcomes, and tests for top, bottom, outside, cross-inventory, cursor-wide, multi-slot, repeated-close, disconnect, and shutdown paths
failIf: an owned view returns before cancellation because the click is in the bottom inventory, outside the window, or not a primary mouse click
InventoryDragEvent is absent or allows a drag when any raw slot is protected or unclassified
shift-click, MOVE_TO_OTHER_INVENTORY, NUMBER_KEY, hotbar swap, SWAP_OFFHAND, DOUBLE_CLICK, or COLLECT_TO_CURSOR can bypass the allowed-slot policy
a button click is uncancelled even though the handler manually applies its GUI action
deprecated InventoryClickEvent.setCursor is used for a manual cursor mutation

diagnostics.title: Administrative command surface is incomplete or cannot be operated safely
detectWhen: Paper plugin code creates an administrator, moderator, operator, configuration, maintenance, or recovery command

requiredChecks: map required mutation, inspection, reload, retry, repair, reset, and recovery operations to syntax or an explicitly documented alternative

require an explicit target for privileged subject operations and justify online-only versus offline-capable resolution
resolve player-facing input to a stable known identity and distinguish offline subjects from unknown or never-registered input
enforce an explicit least-privilege permission policy for every privileged branch at execution time
use typed bounded arguments, route secrets through a protected non-command mechanism, and require deliberate preview or confirmation for destructive or all-target scope
validate a complete reload candidate before atomic publication, retain the last valid state on failure, keep I/O off the main server thread, and define concurrency and Bukkit publication behavior
return typed outcomes to the invoker and separately define target notification, effective-state inspection, and bounded non-secret auditing
test supported and rejected sender kinds, self, other, online, supported offline, missing, denied, invalid, I/O failure, rollback, retry, partial, bulk-confirmation, and secret-redaction paths
evidence: an operation matrix covering syntax, mutation, sender, target, permission, outcomes, and post-change verification
target-version Paper API type/member evidence for command sender, target, permission, scheduler, and messaging APIs used
state-transition and reload tests proving atomic publication and last-known-good preservation
command tests covering sender, target, denial, failure, observability, recovery, retry, and bulk boundaries
failIf: an operation is player-only even though it requires no player-local input and has no explicit console-capable form
remote console, command block, command minecart, proxied sender, custom sender, or unknown sender behavior is silently inherited from a generic CommandSender executor
a privileged subject operation silently uses the invoker as its target
a database-only or configuration-only change unnecessarily requires an online Player

only the affected target is notified while a different player invoker or the console receives no result
no list, show, or status path can verify the effective state after a change
a retry can duplicate a completed mutation without an idempotency or duplicate-result policy
safeResponse: Define the complete operation matrix before generating command branches.

detectWhen: plugin code decodes a plugin message, custom payload, RPC request, response, or chunk

scope request IDs to the connection/session and define duplicate, idempotency, one-terminal-response, timeout, cancellation, reconnect, close, and disable behavior

Use the authenticated connection or trusted proxy boundary as the authority and treat payload identity as untrusted data.

diagnostics.failureMode: A protocol that merely parses successful examples can remain exploitable through spoofing, oversized or compressed payloads, duplicate delivery, stale correlations, state leaks, and unsafe execution.
